استزرنا (form X)
# اِسْتَزَرْنَا (istazarnā) /is.ta.zar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
# اُسْتُزِرْنَا (ustuzirnā) /us.tu.zir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
